name: Disbandment Plan
description: The controlled dissolution of a forum (G-11): a plan, the named approvals, a successor and a records disposition decision. Disbandment makes the forum inactive; nothing is deleted and retention continues to apply.

fields.label: Trigger Scenario
fields.options:
Annual Inventory Review
Self Assessment
Charter Review
Mandate Complete
Other

fields.label: Records Disposition Note
fields.description: What becomes of the forum's records. Retention still applies; this is the decision, not the disposal.

fields.label: Approvals
fields.description: The four approvers G-11 names. Each decision is a Core Approval Decision.

fields.label: Executed On
fields.description: When the disbandment was actually applied to the forum.
